metadata.description: Properties-only index (state_name/district_name/district_lgd, no geometry) for Python scripts that iterate districts by name -- fetch_crop_stats.py, fetch_mandi_prices.py, etc -- without needing the ~20MB boundary geometry file or a network fetch. Regenerate via scripts/build_districts_index.py whenever districts.geojson changes upstream.
